title: Travel: John Lennon – Nice to London | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono travelled Nice in France to London, England, on 22 May 1971.

They had been in Cannes on the French Riviera for the premieres of their films Fly and Apotheosis, and to attend the Cannes Film Festival, and spent several more days in France before returning to England in time for a recording session at Tittenhurst Park in the afternoon.
